'''Daru'da''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During her work, she was visited by [[Voidhound|Ace]] who was sent by [[Momi Andrell]] to deliver the samples to her. Daru'da was quite interested in these samples and went on to clone the [[shanjaru]].<ref name="SOS" />
